display.purpose: The single marketing headline (login); extra-bold, 110% width.

page-title.purpose: The one heading of an app screen (category name or "Todas as tarefas"); 110% width.

wordmark.purpose: "RoutinXP" set in text, kept as a fallback only. The UI shows the horizontal logo (public/marca/routinxp-logo-horizontal.svg): 2.75rem tall on the login, 2.125rem in the top bar.

headline.purpose: Titles inside panels, dialogs, empty states and simple pages.

body-lead.purpose: One supporting paragraph under a display headline, muted, max 46ch.

body.purpose: Default text; tabular figures on at the root.

row-title.purpose: Task titles (clamped to two lines) and rail items.

meta.purpose: Category line, due dates, counts, hints, secondary figures.

segment.purpose: Segmented filter labels, sentence case with a count.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels, toggles, rail title, Lista group headings, Quadro column titles.

badge.purpose: NÍVEL pill; 0.8125rem inside the login level meter.

xp-figure.purpose: XP counter, +n XP labels and the streak figure; tabular, counts up.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Token --shadow. Every panel, rail, dialog, account menu and toast; the single elevation.

shadows.name: fab-glow
shadows.purpose: Floating action button over content (60rem and below).

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused input, with a Soft Violet border.

shadows.name: selected-inset
shadows.purpose: Selected rail item on desktop; neutral outline, not a lift.

shadows.name: swatch-ring
shadows.purpose: Checked color swatch in the category dialog.

shadows.name: level-up-pulse
shadows.purpose: Transient, at the peak of the badge pulse on level change.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Token --ease-out. The single easing for every state transition and fill.

motion.name: xp-fill
motion.purpose: XP bar fill via translateX; matches the 700ms count-up (quartic ease-out).

motion.name: xp-flight
motion.purpose: Login demo: +n XP flying from the row's XP label to the demo counter; scale 1.1 to 0.75, fades in the last 20%.

motion.name: xp-flight-app
motion.purpose: App: fixed-position +n XP (1rem, 800, green) from the completed row's check or the Quadro drop point to the top bar's XP figure; scale 1.15 to 0.75, fades in the last 20%. Stats apply on arrival; 850ms fallback timer. No flight for 0 XP.

motion.name: level-hold
motion.purpose: Bar holds full in the old level before snapping (no transition) to the new level; badge pulses. No animation on first load or stats resync.

motion.name: level-toast-delay
motion.purpose: After the flight lands, the level toast waits for the fill-and-hold to play out before appearing.

motion.name: check-pop
motion.purpose: App task check on completion (login demo: 0.4s, 1.18).

motion.name: row-completed-wash
motion.purpose: Just-completed row flashes green and settles.

motion.name: notice-in
motion.purpose: Error notice and level-up banner entrance.

motion.name: toast-timer
motion.purpose: Undo toast time bar. Error and info toasts dismiss at 6s, the level toast at 5s.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Rail pencil and row Excluir overlay on hover/focus.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover color, border and background changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation and transition; count-up jumps to the target.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: login becomes one 30rem column; app top bar wraps the level pill to a second row, rail becomes edge-bleeding chips, FAB replaces + Nova tarefa, page title 1.5rem, dialog fields stack.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: Quadro columns scroll-snap horizontally at 86%; the row date moves to the category line in Quadro.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.purpose: Row Excluir overlay hidden; deletion lives in the edit dialog.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid action per form; full width in a login footer, right-aligned in dialogs. Compact 40px variant only in the top bar.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3v10M3 8h10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>Nova tarefa</button> <button class="ds-btn ds-btn--compacto">Nova tarefa</button>

components.name: Link Button

narrative.overview:
RoutinXP follows the gamified learning-platform convention (DIO as the reference, Duolingo and Habitica as the craft bar) rather than an invented world. The system exists to make one moment land: a task is finished, "+n XP" flies to the counter, the number counts up, the bar fills, and on a level change the badge pulses. Everything else is quiet dark chrome that lets that moment be the brightest thing on screen.

Surfaces are a near-black ground with slightly lifted panels, separated by 1px rules. Density is operational, not editorial: rows, fields and meters sit close, labels are small uppercase, and figures are tabular so numbers never jitter while counting. Type is one family, Archivo, pushed to extra-bold and slightly expanded for the headline, page title, wordmark and badges; everything else is plain weight at normal width. Inside the app the level meter lives in the top bar on every screen, which is where the North Star gets its name.

Two accents carry all meaning, and both are taken from the RoutinXP logo (Action Violet and Level Green are the logo's own violet and green). Green is progress (XP, level, fills, completed checks, the completion drop target). Purple is action (primary buttons, the FAB, the active tab bar, focus, link text). Selection is neutral. Every color is a custom property on `:root` so a later theme can swap the whole set by overriding variables on a `[data-tema]` scope; the system must stay expressible that way.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground, lifted panels, 1px rules; no nested cards. App chrome sits one step darker than the ground.
Exactly two accents with fixed jobs: green = XP, level and completion; purple = actions. Selection is neutral.
Archivo variable, extra-bold and 110-112.5% width for display, page title, wordmark and badges.
Tabular figures everywhere; XP numbers animate by counting, never by swapping.
Category color is data, shown as an 8px dot beside the category name (the color picker swatch is the only fill).
Motion is one ease-out curve; reduced-motion collapses it to near zero.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Green means progress and purple means action; neither ever stands in for the other. No green buttons, no purple XP, no third accent. Purple never marks selection: a selected rail item, chip, segment or swatch is shown with neutrals (Panel Two, Rule Strong, Ink). The single violet indicator is the active underline-tab bar, which marks the current mode. Green is also never spent on something that earned nothing: a "+0 XP" is Muted, and no flight launches for it.

rules.name: The Neutral Error Rule
rules.body: Errors are not red. An error is a notice on `panel-2` with a small pill tag in inverted neutrals (ink fill, ground text) reading "ERRO", followed by a plain-language sentence. This keeps the palette to two accents and keeps failure unalarming. The same holds for due dates: today and overdue get Ink and weight, never red. And it holds for reduced rewards: when a completion earns less than usual (task created under 5 minutes ago, the daily XP cap reached or partly reached), an info toast names the reason in a plain sentence, in neutrals, with no tag and no red.

rules.name: The Dot-Only Category Rule
rules.body: User-chosen category colors are data. They appear as an 8px round dot beside the category name (rail, chips, row category line, Lista group headings), never as fills, borders, text color, or backgrounds, and never without the name. The one exception is the color picker, where the swatch itself is the choice and fills a 36px circle.

rules.name: The Swappable Theme Rule
rules.body: Components read colors only through the `:root` custom properties, effects included (glows, washes, halos, backdrop). A new theme is a new set of variable values, not new component CSS. The only color literals outside `:root` are the category swatch values, which are user data.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set at the root and stays on; counting XP must never shift its neighbors.

rules.name: The Width-for-Rank Rule
rules.body: Only display, page title, wordmark and badges use the expanded width axis. Body, rows, rail, dialogs and forms stay at normal width.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: A panel has exactly one elevation. Content inside a panel is never another shadowed card; it is divided by rules. The level pill inside the top bar is a bordered Panel fill with no shadow.

rules.name: The Earned Record Rule
rules.body: In the app's Concluídas, an earned "+n XP" stays full-strength Level Green: it is the record of what the task earned. A "+0 XP" is Muted because it records that nothing was earned, not because anything was collected. The login demo dims its completed "+n XP" to 40% only because there the XP has visibly flown to the counter, and the dimmed label reads as "already collected". Do not carry the dimming into real lists.

dos: Do read every color, including glows, washes, halos and the backdrop, through the `:root` custom properties so a theme can replace them in one place.
Do keep green for XP, level and completion, and purple for actions and focus; use Soft Violet when violet must be read as text.
Do mark selection with neutrals: Panel Two fill plus a Rule Strong outline or border.
Do put Deep Moss text on green fills and white text on violet fills.
Do separate content inside a panel with 1px Rules; list items are rows, not cards.
Do show category color as an 8px dot next to the category name; only the color picker fills a shape with it.
Do use underline tabs to switch views and the segmented pill to filter rows within a view.
Do show due dates relatively ("hoje", "amanhã", "12 set"), with today and overdue in Ink and weight.
Do keep an earned "+n XP" full-strength green in real lists; it is the earned record. Show "+0 XP" and the pending "…" in Muted.
Do name the reason in a neutral info toast when a completion earns less than usual.
Do apply XP only when the flight lands, with a fallback timer so a stalled animation never withholds it.
Do use the horizontal logo as the wordmark (2.75rem login, 2.125rem top bar) and the icon as favicon.
Do report errors with the neutral notice and its ERRO pill tag.
Do animate XP by count-up plus a `translateX` fill on the shared ease-out `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and let reduced-motion collapse it.
Do keep primary buttons and inputs at least 48px tall and completion targets at least 44px.
Do draw new icons on the 16px grid with a 2px round-capped stroke in `currentColor`.
donts: Don't add a third accent, or use red for errors, overdue dates or deletion.
Don't use purple, a colored side stripe, or the category color to mark a selected item.
Don't fill, border or tint surfaces with category colors.
Don't nest a shadowed card inside a panel.
Don't use hard or offset shadows; the only shadows are the soft lift, the violet glows, the focus halo, the selected inset, the swatch ring and the transient level-up pulse.
Don't add mascots, confetti, or streak-loss warnings in alarm colors; the reward is the XP flight, the fill and the badge pulse.
Don't fly or color green an XP gain of zero, or show a reduced reward in red.
Don't set body, rows or forms in the expanded width; that axis is for display, page title, wordmark and badges.
Don't hardcode hex or rgb literals in component CSS; add a token instead.
Don't show placeholder numbers while stats load; use the neutral skeleton.
